skipped.public_gap: RandomSplitDamage always includes native Spell Damage and has no immune-to-spellpower coefficient. Full raw tag 349 explicitly forbids that bonus. Do not compensate by subtracting current power or run a parallel split executor.

skipped.public_gap: No public fill-board-from-pool request or full host capacity input in RuleContext; fixed seven summons fails actual max_board=8 and cannot represent arbitrary capacity/occupancy. Existing FillBoardWithCopies is physical copy, not random fresh pool summons.

record.name: 冰脊剑龙
record.text: 战吼：随机对两个敌方随从造成2点伤害。延系：并将其冻结。
record.text_en: [x]Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to two random enemy minions. _Kindred: And Freeze them.

skipped.public_gap: Native Kindred prepare can sample a two-target group, but RequestChoice on_select does not retain c.kindred or transport the selected group into later active components. Existing frozen-group freeze sequences require an actual SPELL cast, not the minion Battlecry. Whole random damage plus matched original two-target Freeze is not implemented.

local_policies.dynamic_numbers: Explicit internal additive profiles: CATA_581 script base1 plus initial physical BOARD minion count including dormant occupants; JAIL_200 base2 plus all completed original own HERO character attacks. Full raw plus omitted dynamic display do not independently certify these formulas; each profile and CN window remain M6 policies. TLC_517 has no current runtime adapter.
local_policies.decimation: Capture one additive base1 plus the original physical BOARD minion count, including dormant occupants. Only current active/living minions receive the simultaneous SPELL DamageBatch. Exact CN additive formula and window remain M6.
local_policies.scullery: Use validated character_attack_history: source_kind HERO, original declaration player, terminal completed with actual combat. Includes forced attacks and zero-damage actual combats; cancelled declarations and rewind-discarded attempts do not count. No voluntary-only HeroAttackQuery.
local_policies.disciple: Capture 1 plus current held Dragon minion count before any destruction; each ordinary RequestChoice draw independently samples the new shared active/living board, excluding the original source allocation ID. Original MinionReference protects each selected residence. Full unknown current tribe facts raise.
local_policies.watchman: Native Disguised entry. Capture entered source controller for both waves, re-query that side before each 1-point MINION_ABILITY simultaneous batch, excluding source allocation. Original payment actor is separate from destination.

deferred_attempted_policies.knockback: Use deck_shuffles.capture_cost complete original operation facts; unknown issuer raises. One two-card semantic shuffle adds one, placements and opponent operations add none.
deferred_attempted_policies.hound: Native Prepare; capture original source and every enemy active/living board residence in board order, delegate all ForceAttack requests to the existing combat executor. Death, control and same-ID reentry follow original presence guards.
deferred_attempted_policies.dreamsaber: Native hand Battlecry uses its actual accepted play price; actual indirect entry without original play uses the ordinary current physical cost quote. Engine RequestChoice samples up to two distinct enemies once. Both source/targets use captured BoardPresenceReference; no resampling when a target/source departs. Basis and two-target order await M6.
